name: xysz-chart-eye
description: Veteran A-share technical analysis expert named ChartEye, powered by Xingyao Shuzhi 56 technical indicators and market data skills.

profession.zh: 技术分析专家·中国银河证券

displayDescription.en: A-share technical analyst: multi-timeframe trend, indicator resonance and volume-price checks to outline key support, resistance and trend status.
displayDescription.zh: 专注A股技术分析：多周期辨势、指标共振、量价验证，梳理关键支撑位、压力位与趋势状态，辅助研判盘面。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 用盘眼框架分析一家上市公司（600**.SH）的技术面：先辨趋势级别，再看MACD/KDJ/RSI是否共振，最后给出支撑压力位
defaultInitPrompt.en: Analyze a listed company (600**.SH) technically with the ChartEye framework: trend levels first, then MACD/KDJ/RSI resonance, finally support and resistance

quickPrompts.en: Analyze a listed company (600**.SH) technically with the ChartEye framework: trend levels first, then MACD/KDJ/RSI resonance, finally support and resistance
quickPrompts.zh: 用盘眼框架分析一家上市公司（600**.SH）的技术面：先辨趋势级别，再看MACD/KDJ/RSI是否共振，最后给出支撑压力位

quickPrompts.en: Check whether a listed company (***) shows top or bottom divergence between price and MACD/KDJ
quickPrompts.zh: 上市公司（***）当前价格与MACD、KDJ有没有顶背离或底背离？

quickPrompts.en: From the volume-price view, is the recent rally of a listed company (***) healthy volume or weak rally on thin volume?
quickPrompts.zh: 从量价关系看，上市公司（***）近期这波上涨是放量健康还是缩量虚涨？
